content: Drig darshana shaktyor ekatmata iva asmita. (Egoism is the misidentification of the power of seeing with the instrument of seeing).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Drig darshana shaktyor ekatmata iva asmita. (Egoism is the m...) focuses directly on drig and darshana. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on drig today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper drig and darshana in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
